customManagers.description: Track the Rust toolchain pinned in rust-toolchain.toml (kept in lockstep with .mise.toml, see the Rust toolchain group).

packageRules.description: mise is pinned as MISE_VERSION in every workflow that sets it up; move them at once, and only to a release a day old, the age mise-action waited for before the pin.
Automerge digest, pin, patch, and minor updates once CI passes.

Hold cosign-installer on v3, which installs cosign 2.x. v4 installs cosign 3, whose sign-blob writes a newer bundle format, and the bundles the release publishes are verified by whatever cosign each user has installed (tgt update --require-signature). Lift this after checking which cosign versions read the new format.
Group the remaining Rust crate updates into one PR.
ratatui and crossterm are a matched pair: crossterm 0.29 belongs to ratatui 0.30. Moving one without the other breaks the backend.
The OpenTelemetry crates are version-locked to each other; a partial bump does not compile.
tdlib-rs changes the vendored TDLib and therefore the shipped dylib name and packaging. Always review by hand.
tracing-batteries is a git pin that is currently unused (architecture.md §6.4); leave it alone until it is either wired up or dropped.
The Rust toolchain is pinned in .mise.toml and rust-toolchain.toml, which must never disagree.
cargo-insta is pinned in .mise.toml and the insta crate in Cargo.toml; the CLI reviews what the crate writes, so move them at once.
The docs site and the demo recording ship nothing, so a fix(deps) there would cut a release for a dependency nobody gets.
Leave engines.node alone. It describes the Node versions VuePress supports, not the toolchain .mise.toml pins.

Hold the docs site on TypeScript 6 and below. TypeScript 7 is the native compiler and has no JavaScript API, and @vue/compiler-sfc reads files through that API (ts.sys) to resolve imported prop types in the theme's components, so the docs build fails on it. Lift this once @vue/compiler-sfc no longer needs it.
The commit message check must parse with the release-please version the release-please action bundles (see its package-lock.json), not the newest one. Bump it by hand alongside the action.
